（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S. B. REGISTRY. No. D 8/6 June Date 1935 6/25）

A/Commissioner of Police.

Sir,

Proposed Changes in Special Branch

In order to relieve congestion in the offices of the Special Branch in the new building, it will be necessary to transfer the Boarding-House Section to the office originally intended for Film Censorship and to divide the staff of the latter section between the Translators' Bureau and the Registry in both of which offices there is some vacant space.

The Boarding-House Section will then be on the 3rd floor and the Indian Section on the 2nd floor. I propose subject to your approval, to place these two sections under the same officer.

This arrangement will increase the efficiency of S. 2 as the section specially intended for dealing with Communist matters; and will not interfere with the efficiency of the Boarding-House Section or its usefulness to D.C. (Crime) and the Special Branch.

The efficiency of S. 2 will be increased by relieving the officer in charge of S. 2 of miscellaneous duties not strictly within his province, such as inquiries regarding applications for licences, locating of people lost, checking records of applicants to join S.V.C. Russian, Unit, etc. etc.

The efficiency of S. 2 will be maintained because D.S. Sansom will remain in immediate charge under D.S.I. Golder. Both of these officers have had several years' experience in the Crime Branch and Special Branch.

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 特科档案室。编号 D 8/6 日期 1935年6月25日）

致警务处处长阁下：

关于特科的拟议变更

为缓解新大楼内特科办公室的拥挤状况，有必要将寄宿公寓管理股迁至原定为电影审查所用的办公室，并将后一股的人员分派至翻译股和档案室，这两个办公室均尚有空余空间。

此后，寄宿公寓管理股将位于三楼，印度人事务股位于二楼。我建议，在获得您批准的前提下，将这两个股置于同一名警官管辖之下。

此安排将提高专门负责处理共产党事务的 S.2 股的效率；且不会干扰寄宿公寓管理股的效率及其对刑事侦缉处（犯罪组）和特科的效用。

通过免除 S.2 股主管那些并不严格属于其职权范围的杂务，如查询执照申请、寻找失踪人员、核查加入上海义勇军俄国分队申请人的记录等，S.2 股的效率将得到提高。

S.2 股的效率将得以维持，因为丹尼斯·桑瑟姆副督察（D.S. Sansom）将在戈尔德高级副督察（D.S.I. Golder）的直接领导下继续负责该股工作。这两名警官在刑事侦缉处和特科均有多年的工作经验。

Suggestions for Curbing Activities
of Soviet and Communist Agents.
--------------------------------

1.  Compel all foreign boarding-houses to take out licenses
    and supply lists of lodgers.

2.  Compel hotels to supply lists similar to those furnished
    by the boarding-houses.

3.  Increase vigilance in supervision of Chinese hotels and
    lodging-houses.

4.  Comprehensive searches of these establishments should be
    organized frequently both by the officers of stations and
    the Search Parties which operate from Headquarters.

5.  Arrange with shipping companies to give police full lists
    of all passengers arriving with particulars of their
    nationalities and the addresses where they intend to stay.

Commissioner of Police.

Sir,

I wish to bring to your notice that 2 years and
3 months have elapsed since all Communist work was trans-
ferred to S.2. I attach herewith the report which I
submitted on the subject at that time and it will be
seen that the soundness of the arguments put forward in
favour of the change has been demonstrated by many cases
which occurred since then, notably in the Noulens case,
which showed that Foreigners of various nationalities were
working in close co-operation with the Chinese leaders of the
Chinese Communist Party, the Communist Youth League case and
the Military Committee case which also demonstrated the
close co-operation which exists between Communists of
Chinese nationality on the one side and Foreign and Asiatic
Communists, other than Chinese, on the other. The various
issues of the China Forum also help to show the very close
co-operation which exists between Chinese and Foreign
Communists.

Besides ensuring complete co-operation among the
officers who deal with Chinese and Foreign Communists, the
change has resulted in the creation of machinery for the
detection of Communist activities which will be available
irrespective of the attitude of the Chinese Authorities and
improvements in the working of Communist cases and compila-
tion of statistics which entitles the Special Branch to
claim a high measure of efficiency in these respects.

I therefore recommend that the change be made
permanent and shall, subject to your approval, issue orders
regarding the duties of S.2 in accordance with a draft I have
attached.

致警务处处长：

先生，

谨提请阁下注意，自所有共产党相关工作移交至 S.2 股以来，已过去两年零三个月。随函附上我当时就此主题提交的报告，从中可见，支持此项变更的论点之正确性已被此后发生的诸多案件所证实，特别是努伦斯案（Noulens case），该案显示不同国籍的外国人正与中国共产党领导人密切合作；还有共产主义青年团案和军事委员会案，这些案件也证明了华籍共产党人与非华籍的外国及亚洲共产党人之间存在的密切合作。《中国论坛》（China Forum）的各期内容也有助于表明中外共产党人之间存在非常密切的合作。

除了确保处理华籍和外籍共产党人的警官之间的完全合作外，此项变更还建立了一套侦测共产党活动的机制，该机制不受中国当局态度的影响；同时改进了共产党案件的处理工作和统计资料的编制，使特科有理由声称在这些方面具有高度的效率。

因此，我建议将此变更永久化，并在获得您批准后，根据我所附草案发布关于 S.2 股职责的命令。

D. C. (Cr. & Sp. Br's),

It has come to my notice recently that
the French Police are better equipped for obtaining
information about Communists and Communist activities
than the Police of the Settlement. The work there is
entrusted to the 2nd Division of the Political Section
which makes inquiries into all Communist activities,
both Foreign and Chinese, and attends to examination
of papers and documents obtained in searches on
Communist premises or otherwise. The 2nd Division
appears to be able to obtain from day to day through
informers who are directly in touch with the Communists
information regarding the main plans of the Communist
Party. The report made daily by the 2nd Division
under this heading would cover about three full size
sheets of typewriting paper if closely written. The
report contains items of special information and an
analysis in precis form of important features of
information contained in documents found in searches on
Communist bases. Other duties of the 2nd Division
comprise inquiries of a general nature about foreigners.

致刑事侦缉处及特科副处长：

我最近注意到，法国警察在获取有关共产党及共产党活动的情报方面，装备优于本租界警察。那里的工作委托给政治处的第二科，该科调查所有外国和华人的共产党活动，并负责检查在共产党场所搜查中或通过其他途径获得的文件和文书。第二科似乎能够通过直接与共产党接触线人，日复一日地获取关于共产党主要计划的情报。如果写得紧凑，第二科在此标题下每日提交的报告大约占满三张打字纸。该报告包含特别情报项目，并以摘要形式分析在共产党据点搜查中发现的文件中所含的重要信息特征。第二科的其他职责包括对外国人进行一般性质的调查。

法国警察目前在共产党调查方面优于我们的优势，无疑主要归因于他们在常规特工和临时线人身上花费了更多的资金。然而，由其同一批职员处理所有华人和外国人的共产党事务的制度，也赋予了他们巨大的优势。由于这一变更可以在不增加任何额外费用的情况下在我们的特科中实施，我建议立即执行，并将目前从事调查等工作、涉及华籍共产党人的 S.1 股部分人员

I am making this recommendation after having
given the matter a great deal of thought. Apart from
the manner in which I have been influenced by my
observations of the work of the 2nd Division of the
Political Branch of the French Police, I have concluded
that the change would lead to greater efficiency for
the following reasons :-
1. The activities of Communists of Chinese and other
Asiatic nationalities such as Koreans, Formosans,
Annamites, Japanese and Malayans become more closely
interlaced from month to month and the directing
hand of foreigners either in close proximity or at a
distance is discernible in almost all their activities.
2. As a consequence of the foregoing orientation of the
movement tasks frequently have to be performed which
requires the attention not only of officers who
understand the Chinese language and Chinese Communist
affairs, but also in the principal European and
certain Asiatic languages other than Chinese.
3. If the officer in charge of S.1 follows the various
ramifications of the Communist movement with all
the attention which this subject deserves, he is
almost certain to be obliged to neglect some of his
multifarious other important duties. The officer
in charge of S.2, who at present has no work involving
continuous concentration, however, could easily do so.
In view of the heavy responsibility on the officer
dealing with Communist affairs, it is only fair that

1. 华籍及其他亚洲国籍（如朝鲜人、台湾人、安南人、日本人和马来人）共产党人的活动逐月变得更加紧密交织，几乎在他们所有的活动中都能 discernible（察觉）到外国人或在近处或在远处的指挥之手。
2. 鉴于上述运动的导向，经常需要执行一些任务，这不仅要求懂中文及华籍共产党事务的警官关注，还需要掌握主要欧洲语言及某些非中文的亚洲语言的警官关注。

The significance of the first argument is
exemplified in the handbills in English, French, Japanese
and Annamite languages addressed to members of the local
defence forces. This propaganda appears to be the work
of persons of the different nationalities named, but is
distributed by Chinese whose methods, etc. indicate that
they are acting on behalf of a common source.
As regards the second argument, I would like to say
that the Special Branch has for many months been endeavour-
ing to trace the source of "Red" propaganda in English
which has been sent from Shanghai to various cities in
other parts of Asia, Europe and America, but so far have
not been able to establish whether it is the work of
Chinese or foreigners.

Duties of Section No.2. Special Branch.S.M.P.

1. The 2nd Section of the Special Branch shall maintain sur-
veillance over all Communists and Communist activities and shall
submit either to the officer in charge of S.1 or the Officer i/c
Special Branch early information of developments in the movement
which are liable to result in street demonstrations, serious
strikes, sabotage or other disorder.

2. The 2nd Section of the Special Branch shall further maintain
surveillance over political, quasi-political, labour and popular
religious movements among residents of Shanghai, other than
Chinese and Indians and shall submit either to the officer-
in charge of S.1 or the Officer i/c Special Branch early
information of developments in these movements which are likely
to result in street demonstrations, attacks on individual or
institutions or
general disorder.

3. Apart from submitting early information of impending trouble
resulting from Communist activities, irrespective of the section
of the population affected and of all impending trouble among
foreigners, other than Indians, the 2nd Section shall report
from time to time on all Communists and general Communist
activities and on political, quasi-political and religious
movements among Foreigners other than Indians.

在所有应特别分部要求进行的与政治犯罪有关的逮捕或搜查行动中，配合采取行动的区侦探将负责准备由此产生的任何法庭案件。他有责任填写《犯罪日记》等，并安排在需要时将与该案有关的所有证人、文件等带上法庭。在场的高级警官将对到达警察局之前采取的所有执行行动负责。
在逮捕或搜查现场在场的特别分部高级成员将向前述相关区侦探解释上述程序，并提供建议和帮助，使后者能够有效地处理该案。

虽然特别分部成员有责任在案件准备方面提供一切可能的帮助，但除非在异常困难或重要的案件中作为证人确有必要，或在没有站头侦探协助的情况下采取了执行行动，否则分部成员不出庭。

With reference to Memo. 262 issued on June 14,
1930, under the joint signatures of the Deputy
Commissioner (Divisions) and Deputy Commissioner
(C. and S. Branches), the following additional
instructions, having in view the closer co-operation
of Station Detectives and the Special Branch, are
notified for guidance.

When a communist or other political offender is
arrested or when information is obtained by Station
Staffs about important occurrences connected with
labour, communist or political agitations the occurrence
will be reported without delay to the Special Branch.
Arrangements have been made whereby a member of the
Special Branch will always be on duty outside
ordinary office hours and the roster of officers on
this duty will be supplied to Stations at the end of
each month.

On receipt of a report of the above nature the
Special Branch will send officers to the Station
concerned to assist in the investigation and to render
such other help as may be required. In the event of
any doubt as to subsequent procedure the matter will
be referred to the Divisional Officer or to the Officer
i/c Special Branch.
The instructions contained in P.O.No.2367 and
Memo. 262 referred to above are in no way modified by
these instructions.

R.M. J. Martin.

To All Sections of the Special Branch:
Reorganisation of the Special Branch.
Duties of Section 2.

The following is issued in substitution for all
circulars and orders bearing on the duties of Section No.2,
Special Branch, which have been issued previously:

1. The 2nd Section of the Special Branch shall maintain
surveillance over all Communists and Communist activities
and shall admit either to the Officer in charge of S.I or
the Officer i/c Special Branch early information of
developments in the movement which are liable to result
in street demonstrations, serious strikes, sabotage or
other disorder.

2. The 2nd Section of the Special Branch shall further maintain
surveillance over political, quasi-political, labour and
popular religious movements among residents of Shanghai,
other than Chinese and Indians, and shall submit either to
the officer in charge of S.I or the Officer i/c Special
Branch early information of developments in these
movements which are likely to result in street demons-
trations, attacks on individuals or institutions or
general disorder.

3. Apart from submitting early information of impending
trouble resulting from Communist activities, irrespective
of the section of the population affected, and of all
impending trouble among foreigners, other than Indians,
the 2nd Section shall report from time to time on all
Communist and general Communist activities and on
political, quasi-political and religious movements among
foreigners other than Indians.

1935年8月2日。

致特别分部各科：
关于特别分部的改组。
第二科的职责。

现发布以下内容，以取代此前发布的涉及特别分部第二科职责的所有通函和命令：

1. 特别分部第二科应对所有共产党人及共产党活动保持监视，并应尽早向情报科科长或特别分部主管官员报告运动中可能导致街头示威、严重罢工、破坏活动或其他骚乱的事态发展。

2. 特别分部第二科还应对上海居民中除华人和印度人以外的政治、准政治、劳工及民间宗教运动保持监视，并应尽早向情报科科长或特别分部主管官员报告这些运动中可能导致街头示威、攻击个人或机构或一般性骚乱的事态发展。

3. 除了提交因共产党活动（无论影响哪部分人群）以及除印度人以外的外国人中即将发生的麻烦的早期信息外，第二科还应定期报告所有共产党及一般共产主义活动，以及除印度人以外的外国人中的政治、准政治和宗教运动。

pages.en:
4. In order to ensure that the information and reports
mentioned in the foregoing paragraphs will be reliable
and comprehensive the 2nd Section of the Special Branch
shall make special dispositions for obtaining details about
(a) Communists working on behalf of the 3rd International,
(b) Communists engaged on agitation among labourers and students
(c) Movements of a political character among Japanese, Koreans
and Formosans.
(d) Movements among "White" and "Red" Russians.

5. In order to ensure that all the information, to the collection
of which reference is made, will be always readily available,
the staff of the 2nd Section shall keep lists and short
biographies of (a) Foreigners engaged in promoting or helping
Communist activities or engaged in political, quasi-political
or religious movements likely to result in disorder or otherwise
necessitate police interference and names and addresses of
organisations promoted by them, (b) Chinese engaged in
Communist activities and organisations maintained by them.

6. In order to ensure that the information in the lists of
Communists and other agitators is complete and up to date,
the 2nd Section of the Special Branch shall make inquiries at
regular intervals at the boarding-house section, seaport
offices, shipping offices, etc. etc. and shall give special
attention to the writing up of :-
(a) Communist Arrest Book - this contains particulars of
Communists arrested and the result of court proceedings.
(b) Communist Suspect Book - this contains particulars of
Communist suspects wanted on warrants or circular
orders for arrest.
(c) Communist Agitators Cards - these contain particulars
of Chinese and foreigners actively engaged in Communist
work and particulars of prosecutions brought against them.
pages.zh:
4. 为确保上述段落中提及的信息和报告可靠且全面，特别分部第二科应做出特别安排，以获取有关以下方面的细节：(a) 代表第三国际工作的共产党人，(b) 在工人和学生中进行煽动活动的共产党人，(c) 日本人、朝鲜人和台湾人中的具有政治性质的运动，(d) “白”俄和“红”俄中的运动。

5. 为确保随时可获取所提及收集的所有信息，第二科人员应保存以下名单和简短传记：(a) 从事促进或帮助共产党活动，或从事可能导致骚乱或以其他方式需要警方干预的政治、准政治或宗教运动的外国人，以及由他们推动的组织的名称和地址；(b) 从事共产党活动的华人及其维持的组织。

6. 为确保共产党人和其他煽动者名单中的信息完整且最新，特别分部第二科应定期向寄宿公寓管理处、港口办公室、航运公司等处查询，并应特别注意更新以下内容：
(a) 《共产党人逮捕簿》——包含被捕共产党人的详情及法庭诉讼结果。
(b) 《共产党嫌疑犯簿》——包含根据逮捕令或通缉令被通缉的共产党嫌疑犯的详情。
(c) 《共产党煽动者卡片》——包含积极从事共产党工作的华人和外国人的详情，以及针对他们的起诉详情。

pages.en:
(d) Communist Suspect Cards - these contain particulars
of foreigners and Chinese whose activities afford
good ground for suspicion that they are agents for the
promotion of Communism.
(e) Communist Handbill Book - this contains specimens of
handbills obtained by the Police.
(f) Key to Handbill Book - this contains references to the
handbills recorded in the Handbill Book and shows the
time and place of discovery, the source of purported
emanation and character of contents of each handbill.
7. The records of Communist agitators and suspects should
include the name, description, photograph and specimen of
handwriting of each person mentioned as well as particulars
of their relatives and names of persons and places through
which they might be found.
8. In obtaining information about persons and places through
which the whereabouts of Communists may be traced, the
present system of watching the mail of "Red" convicts and
movements of visitors to Red convicts should be developed
as much as possible.
9. The records of Foreign suspects and agitators should be
classified in accordance with their nationality, the
particular line of Communist work in which they are engaged
and the class of the population they endeavour to influence.
10. Records of Communist agitators known to operate among workers
should be sub-classified according to :
(a) the district in which they work.
(b) the form of camouflage they adopt to hide their real
work, i.e., whether they have positions as industrial
operatives, business, waiters, school teachers, boy-scout
organisers, football coaches, etc. etc.
pages.zh:
(d) 《共产党嫌疑犯卡片》——包含其活动提供充分理由怀疑其为促进共产主义代理人的外国人和华人的详情。
(e) 《共产党传单簿》——包含警方获得的传单样本。
(f) 《传单簿索引》——包含对《传单簿》中记录的传单的引用，并显示每份传单的发现时间和地点、据称来源以及内容性质。
7. 共产党煽动者和嫌疑人的记录应包括每个被提及者的姓名、体貌特征、照片和笔迹样本，以及其亲属的详情和可能找到他们的联系人姓名及地点。
8. 在获取可通过之追踪共产党人行踪的人员和地点信息时，应尽可能完善目前监视“红”色囚犯邮件及探访“红”色囚访客动向的制度。
9. 外国嫌疑人和煽动者的记录应按其国籍、从事的共产党工作具体路线以及他们试图影响的人群类别进行分类。
10. 已知在工人中活动的共产党煽动者的记录应按以下方式进行子分类：
(a) 他们工作的地区。
(b) 他们为掩盖真实工作而采取的伪装形式，即他们是否拥有产业工人、商人、服务员、学校教师、童子军组织者、足球教练等职位。

pages.en:
(e) the claims of workers when they try to influence whether
cotton mill workers, silk filature workers, tramway
employees, water works operatives, electricity workers
or students, etc. etc.

11. The Officer in charge of S.2 shall devote special attention
to watching the activities of the section of the Communist
Party known as the Military Committee and its efforts to
undermine the loyalty of the various defence forces of the
Settlement.

12. The Officer in charge of S.2. shall make himself familiar
with the duties of the other sections of the Special Branch
and shall transmit to the officers in charge of these
sections any information obtained by the members of his
staff in the course of their inquiries which is likely to be
helpful to those officers.

13. The staff of S. 2 shall in accordance with the terms of
Memo. No. 862 dated June 14, 1930, Police Order No. 6. 2507
of November 18, 1930 and Memo. by Commissioner of Police
dated May 27, 1931, assist in investigating all cases of a
Communist character.

14. The officer in charge of S.2 shall endorse all reports
made by the members of his staff and pass them to the
officer in charge of Special Branch through the immediate
subordinate of that officer.

J. McLeish
Officer i/c Special Branch.
pages.zh:
(c) 当他们试图施加影响时的工人类别，无论是棉纺厂工人、缫丝厂工人、电车雇员、水厂工人、电力工人还是学生等。

11. 第二科主管官员应特别注意监视被称为军事委员会的共产党部门的活动，及其破坏租界各防卫部队忠诚度的努力。

12. 第二科主管官员应熟悉特别分部其他各科的职责，并将其下属人员在调查过程中获得的、可能对这些官员有帮助的任何信息转交给各科主管官员。

13. 根据1930年6月14日第862号备忘录、1930年11月18日第6.2507号警务命令以及1931年5月27日警务处长备忘录的规定，第二科人员应协助调查所有具有共产党性质的案件。

14. 第二科主管官员应签署其下属人员制作的所有报告，并通过该主管官员的直接下属将其转交特别分部主管官员。

J. McLeish
特别分部主管官员。

报告
主题（全称） 特别分部第二科执行的档案工作。
制作及呈报人 D. I. Ross
鉴于特别分部主管官员于1933年4月28日就特别分部第二科执行的档案工作发出的备忘录，兹列出有关工作详情的清单如下：
(1) 《逮捕簿》，包含被捕共产党人的详情及法庭诉讼结果。
(2) 《嫌疑犯簿》，包含根据通缉令被通缉的共产党嫌疑人的详情。
(3) 《布尔什维克簿》，包含某些知名华人共产党人的背景资料。
(4) 《卡片》，包含被捕华人和外国共产党人的详情及法庭诉讼结果。
(5) 《卡片》，包含本处得知的华人和外国共产党嫌疑人以及华人劳工煽动者的详情。
(6) 《传单簿 A》，包含工部局警务处从各种来源获得的样本副本。
(7) 《传单簿 B》，包含与《A簿》中所示传单相关的详情和/或其他参考资料。
(8) 法国情报报告的归档。
(9) 《卡片》，包含以下详情：
(a) 法国情报报告中提及的外国嫌疑人。
(b) 据报为第三国际代理人的外国人。

SPECIAL BRANCH REORGANIZATION CIRCULAR NO. 3

DUTIES OF SPECIAL BRANCH No. 2

The principal duty of Special Branch No. 2 is to obtain,
as far as possible, information of impending trouble among
foreigners, other than Indians, in the Settlement or adjoining
districts and in the event of actual trouble, to keep in close
touch with members of the public and collect timely information
of movements likely to affect law and order.

The duties of S. 2 will include watching and reporting
on all political, quasi-political and popular religious
movements among the non-Chinese population of Shanghai -
with the exception of Indians - and the watching and reporting
on the activities of political associations and labour
organizations formed by foreigners.

The officer in charge of S. 2 should consult frequently
with the officer in charge of S. 1 in order to secure co-
ordination of the work of both these sections. Although the
specific responsibilities of S. 2 are confined to foreigners,
the members of the staff of this section should seek and report
to the officer in charge of the Section concerned or Officer i/c
Special Branch information of interest regarding the Indians
and Chinese in Shanghai, the undesirable movements amongst
whom are frequently inspired or aided by foreigners. To ensure
that the members of S. 2 will be able to render effective
co-operation in this way they should keep in touch with
happenings among Chinese and Indians by reading the monthly
and other reports of general interest of S. 1 and S. 4.

Other duties of the Special Branch No. 2 will include:

1. To conduct specific investigations and inquiries with which
the Section is entrusted.

2. To make investigations regarding the character of Russians
applicants for firearm licences and Russian applicants for
employment as bodyguards and watchmen.
